subject: Electrical Engineering
title: System on Chip: Everything in One Package
description: One-minute skill: System on Chip: Everything in One Package.

hook.text: Your phone's main chip contains CPU, GPU, modem, AI accelerator, and more — all on one die.

buildup.text: System on Chip (SoC) integrates components that used to be separate chips on a motherboard.

discovery.text: On-chip communication is faster and uses less power than chip-to-chip wiring.

twist.text: SoC design requires expertise in digital, analog, RF, and power — all in one team.

climax.text: Apple's M-series, Qualcomm's Snapdragon, and Samsung's Exynos are all SoCs.

punchline.text: One chip to run the phone — SoC put an entire computer on a fingernail.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of a System on Chip design?
options: It eliminates the need for software altogether
On-chip integration reduces size, power, and latency compared to separate chips
SoCs are easier to manufacture than individual chips
